description_en: Call BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs to delete configurations for multiple domain names at once
description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs批量删除域名配置
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn batch-delete-dcdn-domain-configs --domain-names example.com --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names for which you want to delete configurations. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:

You can specify up to 20 domain names in a single request.

The product of the number of domain names and the number of function names must be 50 or less
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：

一次最多传20个域名。
域名个数乘以 FunctionNames个数，小于等于50
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en: The names of the functions whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple function names with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 function names in a single request. For more function names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次传入最多50个。更多功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html
parameters.name: function_names
